THE LINK IS WRITTEN ONCE. A T-334 row names the T-218 rows that verify it (`verifiedBy`); the T-218 column that says what a place verifies is derived from those links on every run, so the two tables cannot disagree. `alsoVerifies` carries only what no T-334 row states (the seams, the functions the omission table leaves).

NO COUNT LIVES HERE. Each T-334 row names where its full count is held (the use cases of Chapter 3.2, the regions of state-machines.json, the gate rows of table T-043), so adding a use case or a region changes nothing in this file.

The rules about these tables are NOT here -- Chapter 7 holds them. The omission table and the gate table of docs/development-rules/04-verification.md are not specification and stay in that file (JDG-607, JDG-639).
